events.text:
T-397 stays in queue with Nelbin. The call with Endy hasn't happened yet, so nothing needed changing on disk this run.

- **Brief covers all four items:** done. `workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md` has the lead address question, the proposed 20% recurring share, delivery through the service account client ID and three scopes (never Instantly), and price per inbox and turnaround. It also has Endy's published price of $35/mo for 10 inboxes, +$3.50 each.
- **Default lead address:** done, nothing to change. `endy_leads.py:24` falls back to [email]. Neither centre-sheet plist (the repo copy or the one in LaunchAgents) sets `ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL`. Running `target()` returned [email]. The adi@growthclub.org address from the T-213 log is not set anywhere I checked.
- **Note to Nelbin on T-397:** done. It gives the brief's path and the five answers to write on T-213: lead address, revenue share, delivery method, price and turnaround.
- **Call with Endy held:** open. This is Nelbin's to do; I must not contact Endy or book it.
- **Answers written on T-213:** open, waiting on Nelbin after the call. Once that note lands, the next run sets `ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL` on the centre-sheet job, reloads it, runs one sync to confirm and closes T-397.
- **Acks:** F-87b96097 and R-efbb72f4 acknowledged. There was nothing to commit because no files changed.
